data.formal_statement:
namespace ZipfLaw

theorem zipfPMF_variance (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (s : ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * zipfPMF N s k) -
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (k : ℝ) * zipfPMF N s k) ^ 2 =
      genHarmonic N (s - 2) / genHarmonic N s -
        genHarmonic N (s - 1) ^ 2 / genHarmonic N s ^ 2 := by sorry

end ZipfLaw
data.natural_language_statement:
For $N\ge1$ and real $s$, the variance of the rank under the Zipf distribution is
$$\sum_{k=1}^N k^2 f(k;N,s)-\Big(\sum_{k=1}^N k\,f(k;N,s)\Big)^2=\frac{H_{N,s-2}}{H_{N,s}}-\frac{H_{N,s-1}^2}{H_{N,s}^2}.$$
data.source: Wikipedia, "Zipf's law" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zipf%27s_law), snapshot uploaded by the proposer, infobox (Variance $\frac{H_{N,s-2}}{H_{N,s}}-\frac{H^2_{N,s-1}}{H^2_{N,s}}$).

For every natural $N\ge1$ and real $s$:
$$\Big(\sum_{k=1}^N k^2\,\mathrm{zipfPMF}(N,s,k)\Big)-\Big(\sum_{k=1}^N k\,\mathrm{zipfPMF}(N,s,k)\Big)^2=\frac{\mathrm{genHarmonic}(N,s-2)}{\mathrm{genHarmonic}(N,s)}-\frac{\mathrm{genHarmonic}(N,s-1)^2}{\mathrm{genHarmonic}(N,s)^2},$$
with $k^2$ a natural-exponent power of the real $k$.
